campaign_logline: Navigate the fractured remnants of a shattered nebula to recover lost data shards before the Zenith corporation's oversight is revoked.
opening_situation: You wake up in a salvage vessel, the cockpit smelling of ozone and burnt copper. Kaelen stands by the console, her expression unreadable as she notes your disorientation.
main_mystery: The source of the 'Void-Glass'—a crystalline substance that feeds on radiation but produces infinite energy—and who originally engineered it.
act_1_outline: Locate and secure three data shards in the Zenith zone, while avoiding automated security drones.
Establish a trade route between Aurelia outposts to stabilize local economies.
Navigate through the first gate to the outskirts of the Vanguard territory.
long_term_reveal: The Void-Glass is not an energy source; it's a biological byproduct of a dormant, extra-dimensional organism.
tone: Dry, slightly dark PG-13 humor. Minimalist and atmospheric.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity in the Zenith sector; deteriorating ship integrity.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal, her motivations are ambiguous, and her origin remains a mystery.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions (Aurelia, Vanguard) are only revealed through gate travel.
humor_rule: Avoid repetitive jokes. Use dry wit regarding the absurdity of space-commerce.
address_rule: Address Kaelen directly or via internal log updates.
fallback_rule: If a quest goal is unreachable, offer an alternative path to salvage enough scrap for repairs.

story_arcs.name: The Shard Hunt
story_arcs.summary: Recover the missing data shards to unlock the truth about Void-Glass and stabilize your ship's power core.

rumor__trails.name: Whispers of the Old Code
clue_templates: A rhythmic pulse from the derelict station.
An encrypted packet containing coordinates to a buried vault.
rumor__trails.payoff: Unlocks a hidden chamber with an ancient, non-human record of the first jump-gate network.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the player reaches a new system with fewer than three prepared systems left, add a new horizon.
